title: Enable NASA FIRMS active fires with a free MAP_KEY
summary: Karhutla hotspots at 375 m within hours, instead of event-level fire markers only.

outcomes.metric: Fire hotspots a partner reviews within 24 h

risks.title: FIRMS key quota exhausted by public traffic
risks.mitigation: Server-side disk cache; one upstream read per cache window.

risks.title: NASA FIRMS does not answer requests from Vercel (timeouts in production logs)
risks.mitigation: Replaced by GIBS hotspots (gibs-hotspots). Re-open only on a host that reaches FIRMS.
